finding.headline: "The Feeding-Station System"
finding.problem: "At 2am I'm hunting for a clean bottle, the brush, the formula scoop in the dark. I bought too much and can't find any of it. I need a system, not more stuff."
finding.person: Mum with bottles, pump, sterilizer, formula, breast bags scattered; midnight feeds are chaos; wants one station + minimal gear.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (feeding-station blueprint) / Bundle.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
